shared_elements: human figures shown in strict profile
raised arm/hand holding or gesturing with an object
figures aligned in a horizontal register facing the same direction
justification: Both depict human figures in strict profile with distinctive tall headgear and long hair/beard, arranged in a horizontal row with a raised gesturing or object-bearing arm, which is a reasonably specific shared convention. The biggest differences are scale and treatment: A shows many small, schematic, linearly incised figures stacked in multiple registers with objects and altar-like furniture, whereas B shows a couple of large, plastically modelled heads with carefully patterned curls and no register subdivision.
